Al Reem Island Luxury Apartment Makeover Guide: Gate Towers, Marina Square & Shams

7 min read2026-11-04Al Reem Island Executive Living

Al Reem Island is Abu Dhabi's premier urban address for corporate executives, legal advisors, healthcare directors, and financial specialists. Towering developments such as the iconic Gate Towers, Sun & Sky, Marina Square, and Shams Abu Dhabi offer panoramic Arabian Gulf and skyline vistas. However, step inside many high-rise apartments, and you are greeted by generic "rental white" walls, glaring downlights, and cluttered television wiring that fail to match the status of the view outside.

For high-earning professionals with demanding schedules, managing an interior fit-out is unthinkable if it involves endless contractor supervision, elevator permit battles, or lingering construction mess. NASAQ provides a 100% hands-off turnkey transformation service engineered specifically for Al Reem Island high-rise living.

The Executive Makeover: Upgrades with Maximum Impact

High-rise apartments have specific spatial constraints. To maximize elegance without wasting square footage, our architectural team implements three signature upgrades:

The Floating Executive Media Wall

A shallow 60mm flush drywall feature wall that conceals all electrical sockets, Apple TV/gaming consoles, and sound cabling behind an 85" display, backlit by ambient 3000K warm LED ribbons.

Refined Neoclassical Boiserie Panelling

Laser-aligned wall mouldings that transform sterile dining rooms and entrance foyers into sophisticated, European-inspired spaces suitable for high-level evening hosting.

Master Suite Acoustic & Aesthetic Headboards

Full-height acoustic fabric or timber headboard feature walls that isolate the bedroom from corridor noise, paired with bedside pendant drops and warm reading niches.

The 72-Hour "While You Work" Turnkey Protocol

Busy executives cannot spend their workdays answering contractor questions. With NASAQ's disciplined protocol, your project is delivered from design sign-off to handover in just 3 days:

  • Digital Approvals: Review and approve 2D shop drawings and 3D elevations on WhatsApp in 10 minutes.
  • Hands-Off Mobilization: NASAQ books the service elevator, arranges the building management work pass, and lines the entrance with protective materials.
  • Zero-Mess Handover: Active HEPA dust filtration ensures you return from the office to an immaculate, freshly styled living space ready for immediate living.

Navigating High-Rise Logistics & Building Management

High-rise towers in Al Reem Island (managed by Provis, Three60, and private strata bodies) have stringent building rules. NASAQ handles every requirement seamlessly:

  1. Service Elevator Bookings: Securing dedicated loading bay and lift slots during designated delivery hours.
  2. Strict Working Hour Adherence: Silent works scheduled to ensure zero noise complaints from neighboring executive tenants.
  3. Fire & Smoke Sensor Isolation: Coordinating temporary optical smoke detector protection during sanding so building fire alarms are never triggered.

Level-5 Silk Paint: Eliminating Glare Across Skyline Windows

Floor-to-ceiling high-rise windows reveal every imperfection in standard developer paint. NASAQ applies a true Level-5 skim coat finish, machine-sanded to mirror smoothness and coated with washable Jotun Fenomastic silk emulsion—ensuring walls look flawless from daybreak to nighttime city lights.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common Resident & Homeowner Questions.

Direct guidance from our Abu Dhabi interior engineering team.

Can this renovation be executed while I am busy at work during the day?

Yes, 90% of our Al Reem Island clients are busy professionals who hand us the keys or smart lock code. NASAQ manages all building permits, elevator bookings, and site protection, delivering a spotless handover in 72 hours.

Do I need landlord permission if I am a tenant in Gate Towers or Marina Square?

Non-structural enhancements like wall mouldings, feature walls, and paint only require a standard landlord approval letter, which we can provide a pre-filled template for. Many landlords gladly approve because it increases property value.

How do you prevent fire alarms from triggering in high-rise towers?

Our team coordinates temporary optical smoke sensor isolation with building security and utilizes active HEPA vacuum extraction on all sanding equipment.
